'''April 2000 Knoxville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Knoxville, TN on 16 April 2000. [[Jason Hasis]] won it. It is known from Jon Tomayko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d535">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-knoxville-tn-4-16-00d535/ knoxville-tn-4-16-00], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-knoxville-tn-4-16-00d535/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Knoxville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Hasis]]
